name: Sluggish Systems

name: Sharp Gunnery
description: Your weapons deal {value}% more damage.

name: Brittle Frames
description: Your ships have {value}% less hull.

name: Sturdy Frames
description: Your ships have {value}% more hull.

name: Long Watches

description: Your disabled ships are {value}% less likely to be lost for good, and to gain new D-mods.
flavor: Tugs on standby, ready to drag the wounded home.

flavor: The hulls rust from the inside out, and nobody knows why.

flavor: They have heard the stories. They believe them.

name: Lean Logistics
description: Your ships use {value}% fewer supplies each month.

name: Leaky Tanks
description: Your ships use {value}% more fuel.

name: Efficient Drives
description: Your ships use {value}% less fuel.

name: Slow Repairs
description: Your ships repair and recover combat readiness {value}% slower.

name: Quick Repairs

description: Your ships have {value}% more ordnance points.

name: Quick Learners
